title: DAB: single frequency network of three transmitters on 12C
description: tools/scene_sfn3.json (tools/dab_gen.cpp), 4.8 s looped, the DAB block centred on 227.360 MHz (12C): ensemble 10BC 'Kraken SFN' (ECC E0) with Kraken Classic (SId 1001, MPEG Layer II 128 kbit/s UEP 3, a 1125 Hz tone), Kraken Plus (1002, DAB+ 64 kbit/s EEP 3-A, 1750 Hz) and Kraken Talk (1003, DAB+ 32 kbit/s EEP 1-B, 600 Hz), each with a dynamic label naming its coding and tone. Three transmitters send it: North TII 12/3 at 40 deg (0 us, 0 dB), Harbour 12/7 at 150 deg (37.5 us later, -4 dB; phi k+1 on the second carrier of each TII pair, as some real transmitters do), Ridge 31/15 at 260 deg (112.25 us, -8 dB); 20 dB S/N. Expect a talker per transmitter (10BC-12-03, 10BC-12-07, 10BC-31-15) at those bearings; events: the ensemble found, each transmitter, the first service's dynamic label; Listen plays the first service's 1125 Hz tone.

expect.event: Kraken Classic - MPEG Layer II 128 kbit/s UEP 3 - test tone 1125 Hz

title: DAB: one transmitter, six services, 24.4 kHz off the tuner centre
description: tools/scene_single.json (tools/dab_gen.cpp), 4.8 s looped: ensemble 10C2 'Kraken Mux B' from one transmitter (TII 5/1, 300 deg, 18 dB S/N), the block 24 kHz above the tuner centre (227.360 MHz) plus a 370 Hz carrier offset and a 12 ppm sample clock offset. Six services: Kraken One (1201, Layer II 48 kHz 128 kbit/s UEP 3, 375 Hz), Kraken LSF (1202, MPEG-2 Layer II 24 kHz 64 kbit/s UEP 2, 1312.5 Hz), DAB+ Kraken Jazz (1203, 32 kbit/s EEP 1-A, 500 Hz), Kraken Rock (1204, 48 kbit/s EEP 2-A, 2250 Hz), Kraken News (1205, 72 kbit/s EEP 4-A, 3000 Hz, French) and Kraken Pop (1206, 64 kbit/s EEP 3-B, 1500 Hz); the CIF counter wraps (4999 -> 0) and the UTC date turns midnight within the loop, LTO -5 h. Expect the talker 10C2-05-01 at 300 deg, the frequency offset near +24.37 kHz, the events ensemble found and 6 services, and the first service's dynamic label.

expect.event: Kraken One - Layer II 48 kHz - 375 Hz
